title: Peruvian cement despatches increase by 11% in September 2026
summary: Peruvian cement despatches increase by 11% in September 2026
body_markdown: **Peru:** 1.31Mt of cement was shipped in Peru in September 2026, registering an increase of 11% year-on-year. 1.16Mt of cement was produced, equivalent to a growth of 10% year-on-year. 0.89Mt of clinker was produced, representing an increase of 33% compared to September 2025. 0.86Mt of cement was exported, showing a decrease of 17% year-on-year, and 36,083t of clinker was exported, equivalent to a decrease of 49%. **** 71,932t of cement was imported: 82% via the Port of Chancay from Vietnam; 13% via the Tacna Bus Terminal from Chile, and 5% via the Port of Matarani via Vietnam.
